I am answering the question which species, mouse, pig or human has the highest number of genes with regionally elevated expression.

Human
```{r}
total_elevated_human <- sum(180 + 83 + 57 + 110)
print(total_elevated_human)
```
Pig
```{r}
total_elevated_pig <- sum(109 + 157 + 31 + 45)
print(total_elevated_pig)
```
Mouse 
```{r}
total_elevated_mouse <- sum(55 + 185 + 60 + 98)
print(total_elevated_mouse)
```
The highest number of genes with regionally elevated expression was 430 in humans.
